svg.aria-label: How to make a Mai Tai, step by step: Combine ingredients. Add the rum, lime juice, orange liqueur, orgeat and simple syrup to your shaker. Shake. Add crushed ice (or cubes) and shake hard. Pour it all in. Pour everything, ice and all, into a rocks glass. Top it up with more crushed ice if it needs it. Garnish. A sprig of mint and a lime wedge. Cheers!
